containerVersion.name: PoBoy Standalone Data Layer & GA4 Base Tag

parameter.value:
<script>
(function(w,d){
  'use strict';
  var t0=performance.now();
  var AD=['Toasted','Smoked','Spicy','Honey','Garlic','Chipotle','Truffle','Cajun','Crispy','Glazed','Melted','Roasted','Pickled','Seared','Braised','Bourbon','Tangy','Savory','Zesty','Double','Triple','Loaded','Pressed','Herb'];
  var ING=['Provolone','Pastrami','Brioche','Capicola','Salami','Gouda','RoastBeef','Havarti','Muenster','Mortadella','Ciabatta','Sourdough','Prosciutto','Swiss','Cheddar','Bacon','Turkey','Meatball','Baguette','Chorizo','Pepperoni','Fontina','Brie','Camembert'];
  function fn(s){
    var str=typeof s==='string'?s:JSON.stringify(s||Math.random());
    var h=0;for(var i=0;i<str.length;i++){h=(h<<5)-h+str.charCodeAt(i);h|=0;}
    var p=Math.abs(h);
    return AD[p%AD.length]+ING[Math.floor(p/AD.length)%ING.length]+'-'+(1000+(p%9000));
  }
  function uuid(){return 'pb_'+'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g,function(c){var r=Math.random()*16|0,v=c==='x'?r:(r&0x3|0x8);return v.toString(16);});}
  function setC(n,v,days){
    var e='';if(days){var dt=new Date();dt.setTime(dt.getTime()+(days*86400000));e='; expires='+dt.toUTCString();}
    var h=w.location.hostname,p=h.split('.'),dom=p.length>2?'; domain=.'+p.slice(-2).join('.'):'';
    d.cookie=n+'='+encodeURIComponent(v)+e+'; path=/'+dom+'; SameSite=Lax';
  }
  function getC(n){var eq=n+'=',ca=d.cookie.split(';');for(var i=0;i<ca.length;i++){var c=ca[i].trim();if(c.indexOf(eq)===0)return decodeURIComponent(c.substring(eq.length));}return null;}
  var uId=getC('_poboy_user_id')||localStorage.getItem('_poboy_user_id')||uuid();
  var handle=getC('_poboy_friendly_name')||localStorage.getItem('_poboy_friendly_name')||fn(uId);
  setC('_poboy_user_id',uId,730);localStorage.setItem('_poboy_user_id',uId);
  setC('_poboy_friendly_name',handle,730);localStorage.setItem('_poboy_friendly_name',handle);
  var vault={};
  var storedV=localStorage.getItem('_poboy_param_vault')||getC('_poboy_param_vault');
  if(storedV){try{vault=JSON.parse(storedV);}catch(e){vault={};}}
  var qStr=w.location.search?w.location.search.substring(1):'';
  var updated=false;
  if(qStr){
    var pairs=qStr.split('&');
    for(var j=0;j<pairs.length;j++){
      if(pairs[j]){
        var kv=pairs[j].split('=');
        var k='',v='';
        try{k=decodeURIComponent(kv[0]);v=decodeURIComponent(kv[1]||'');}catch(e){k=kv[0];v=kv[1]||'';}
        if(k&&v!==''&&vault[k]!==v){
          vault[k]=v;
          updated=true;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  if(updated||!storedV){
    var vStr=JSON.stringify(vault);
    localStorage.setItem('_poboy_param_vault',vStr);
    setC('_poboy_param_vault',vStr,730);
  }
  var cachedGpsStr=localStorage.getItem('_poboy_gps_cache');
  var parsedGps=null;
  if(cachedGpsStr){try{parsedGps=JSON.parse(cachedGpsStr);}catch(e){}}
  var tz=Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone||'Unknown';
  var tzOffset=-(new Date().getTimezoneOffset()/60);
  var lang=navigator.language||navigator.userLanguage||null;
  var loc={
    city:null,region:null,country:null,country_code:null,
    latitude:parsedGps?parsedGps.latitude:null,
    longitude:parsedGps?parsedGps.longitude:null,
    accuracy_meters:parsedGps?parsedGps.accuracy_meters:null,
    postal_code:null,timezone:tz,timezone_offset_hours:tzOffset,language:lang,
    location_source:parsedGps?'gps_cached':'timezone_inferred',
    permission_status:parsedGps?'granted':'prompt'
  };
  var getParam=function(k){return vault[k]||null;};
  var utms={utm_source:getParam('utm_source'),utm_medium:getParam('utm_medium'),utm_campaign:getParam('utm_campaign'),utm_term:getParam('utm_term'),utm_content:getParam('utm_content'),utm_id:getParam('utm_id')};
  var cids={gclid:getParam('gclid'),wbraid:getParam('wbraid'),gbraid:getParam('gbraid'),fbclid:getParam('fbclid'),msclkid:getParam('msclkid'),ttclid:getParam('ttclid'),li_fat_id:getParam('li_fat_id'),twclid:getParam('twclid'),irclickid:getParam('irclickid'),affiliate_id:getParam('affiliate_id')||getParam('ref')||null};
  var ch='Direct';if(cids.gclid||cids.wbraid||cids.gbraid)ch='Paid Search (Google)';else if(cids.fbclid)ch='Paid Social (Meta)';else if(cids.msclkid)ch='Paid Search (Bing)';else if(cids.ttclid)ch='Paid Social (TikTok)';else if(utms.utm_medium)ch='Campaign ('+utms.utm_medium+')';else if(d.referrer&&d.referrer.indexOf('google.')!==-1)ch='Organic Search';
  var ua=navigator.userAgent,os='Desktop OS',br='Browser';
  if(/Windows/i.test(ua))os='Windows';else if(/Mac OS/i.test(ua))os='macOS';else if(/Android/i.test(ua))os='Android';else if(/iPhone|iPad/i.test(ua))os='iOS';
  if(/Chrome/i.test(ua))br='Google Chrome';else if(/Safari/i.test(ua))br='Apple Safari';else if(/Firefox/i.test(ua))br='Mozilla Firefox';else if(/Edg/i.test(ua))br='Microsoft Edge';
  var conn=navigator.connection||{};
  var getM=function(n){var el=d.querySelector('meta[name="'+n+'"], meta[property="'+n+'"]');return el?el.getAttribute('content')||null:null;};
  var getL=function(r){var el=d.querySelector('link[rel="'+r+'"]');return el?el.getAttribute('href')||null:null;};
  var schemas=[];var sTags=d.querySelectorAll('script[type="application/ld+json"]');for(var k=0;k<sTags.length;k++){try{schemas.push(JSON.parse(sTags[k].innerText||sTags[k].textContent));}catch(e){}}
  var h1Elements=d.querySelectorAll('h1');var h1s=[];for(var m=0;m<h1Elements.length;m++){h1s.push(h1Elements[m].innerText.trim());}
  var h2Elements=d.querySelectorAll('h2');var h2s=[];for(var n=0;n<h2Elements.length;n++){h2s.push(h2Elements[n].innerText.trim());}
  var schemaTypes=[];for(var p=0;p<schemas.length;p++){schemaTypes.push(schemas[p]['@type']||'Thing');}
  var tStr=localStorage.getItem('_poboy_touches'),tData={first_touch:null,visit_count:0};
  if(tStr){try{tData=JSON.parse(tStr);}catch(e){}}
  var curTouch={timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),page:w.location.href,channel_group:ch,utms:utms,click_ids:cids,vault_params:vault};
  if(!tData.first_touch)tData.first_touch=curTouch;
  tData.last_touch=curTouch;tData.visit_count=(tData.visit_count||0)+1;
  localStorage.setItem('_poboy_touches',JSON.stringify(tData));
  var execTime=(performance.now()-t0).toFixed(3);
  var ftSource=(tData.first_touch&&tData.first_touch.utms&&tData.first_touch.utms.utm_source)?tData.first_touch.utms.utm_source:'direct';
  var ftCampaign=(tData.first_touch&&tData.first_touch.utms&&tData.first_touch.utms.utm_campaign)?tData.first_touch.utms.utm_campaign:'direct';
  var payload={
    identity:{
      user_id:uId,
      friendly_handle:handle,
      friendly_username:handle
    },
    session:{
      session_id:'sess_'+Math.random().toString(36).substring(7),
      session_number:1,
      session_page_views:1,
      visit_count:tData.visit_count,
      is_first_visit:tData.visit_count===1,
      is_returning_user:tData.visit_count>1
    },
    attribution:{
      channel_group:ch,
      first_touch_source:ftSource,
      first_touch_campaign:ftCampaign,
      utms:utms,
      click_ids:cids
    },
    parameters:{
      vault:vault,
      current_url_query:w.location.search||null
    },
    location:loc,
    meta:{
      page_title:d.title,
      page_location:w.location.href,
      page_path:w.location.pathname,
      description:getM('description')||getM('og:description'),
      keywords:getM('keywords'),
      author:getM('author'),
      robots:getM('robots'),
      viewport:getM('viewport'),
      canonical_url:getL('canonical'),
      favicon_url:getL('icon')||getL('shortcut icon'),
      charset:d.characterSet||d.inputEncoding||null,
      heading_h1:h1s[0]||null,
      all_h1_texts:h1s.length>0?h1s:null,
      heading_h2_first:h2s[0]||null
    },
    social:{
      og_title:getM('og:title'),
      og_type:getM('og:type'),
      og_image:getM('og:image'),
      og_url:getM('og:url'),
      og_site_name:getM('og:site_name'),
      twitter_card:getM('twitter:card'),
      twitter_title:getM('twitter:title'),
      twitter_image:getM('twitter:image')
    },
    schema:{
      json_ld:schemas.length>0?schemas:null,
      types_list:schemaTypes.join(', ')||null
    },
    dom_metrics:{
      total_h1_count:h1s.length,
      total_h2_count:h2s.length,
      total_links_count:d.links.length,
      total_images_count:d.images.length,
      total_forms_count:d.forms.length,
      total_scripts_count:d.scripts.length,
      dom_nodes_count:d.getElementsByTagName('*').length
    },
    device:{
      category:/Mobi|Android|iPhone/i.test(ua)?'Mobile':'Desktop',
      os_name:os,
      browser_name:br,
      screen_resolution:screen.width+'x'+screen.height,
      viewport_size:w.innerWidth+'x'+w.innerHeight,
      hardware_concurrency:navigator.hardwareConcurrency||null,
      device_memory_gb:navigator.deviceMemory||null,
      connection_type:conn.effectiveType||conn.type||'unknown'
    },
    performance:{
      execution_time_ms:parseFloat(execTime)
    },
    user_id:uId,
    friendly_handle:handle,
    channel_group:ch,
    gclid:cids.gclid||null,
    fbclid:cids.fbclid||null,
    page_title:d.title,
    page_location:w.location.href,
    referrer:d.referrer||'direct'
  };
  w.dataLayer=w.dataLayer||[];
  w.dataLayer.push({event:'poboy_loaded',poboy:payload});

  if(navigator.geolocation){
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      function(pos){
        var gpsLoc={
          city:null,region:null,country:null,country_code:null,
          latitude:pos.coords.latitude,
          longitude:pos.coords.longitude,
          accuracy_meters:pos.coords.accuracy,
          postal_code:null,timezone:tz,timezone_offset_hours:tzOffset,language:lang,
          location_source:'gps_permission_granted',
          permission_status:'granted'
        };
        payload.location=gpsLoc;
        localStorage.setItem('_poboy_gps_cache',JSON.stringify(gpsLoc));
        w.dataLayer.push({event:'poboy_gps_updated',poboy:payload});
      },
      function(err){
        payload.location.permission_status='denied_or_dismissed';
      },
      {enableHighAccuracy:true,timeout:10000,maximumAge:300000}
    );
  }
})(window,document);
</script>
